body:
Well it was the average saturday night for me and my buddies, I bought a carton of beer and my friends bought their own , it started off okay chatting, drinking, chilling until I all of a sudden woke up on my bedroom floor,
I wondered what the hell had happened because my memory fades from around midnight.
Well they told me the next morning when I got up from my horrible sleep, I began running around and dancing like a moron, fell on the floor countless of times and then attempted to kiss my friend which I found highly disturbing because I am definitely not towards the gay tendency side, I then proceeded to be violently ill puking what they said was red liquid then collapsed on the floor, I don't know if my medication may of played a part in this(I take 10mg of paroxetine a day) but I can't be too sure all I know is I think I need to reconsider my alcohol usage.
